column1: Why is root passed as a pointer-to-pointer rather than a plain node, and what must happen when the slot you are looking at is already NULL (including the very first insert into an empty tree)? As you descend, what does the sign of cmpf's result tell you about going toward left versus right, and where exactly does the new node finally get attached?

The nodes these tests make come from the grader's own btree_create_node, as the subject says they will from exercise 01 on, never from your ex00: a red here is this exercise's own. Is the prototype layer green too? It checks that your ft_btree.h holds the t_btree the subject prints, which the grader's nodes are built on.
